about: the same question against empty customers and orders tables

json.chatInput: Which three customers spent the most in October 2026, and how many orders did each place? Ignore refunded orders.

connector.none: no captured Postgres connector; both sides query the seeded sidecar

reads.note: agent tool: Postgres executeQuery with model-written SQL ($fromAI('sql_statement')), so the queries (schema discovery included) are model-driven and only a seeded database can answer them. Tables: public.customers(id integer primary key, name text, email text, country text, created_at timestamptz, notes text); public.orders(id integer primary key, customer_id integer, order_date date, total_eur numeric(10,2), status text). Both tables exist with these columns and no rows

branches: no IF/Switch; every query returns zero rows, so the answer should say there is no data
expect.offline: The postgres credential points at the bench's sidecar host; the db seed must be loaded before the run (the tables and column types are in the read's note). Simple Memory keeps the session's history in n8n's process only; one message per run
expect.n8nCannotRun: the agent's only data is a Postgres database it queries with SQL it writes, and the bench has no database sidecar yet (PROPOSALS P66), so n8n's Postgres tool cannot connect once the model calls it
